summary: All six artifacts address both analyzer copies, all ten chunk cases, both quiet cases, and both cumulative-fallback cases. They distinguish mocked calls from actual egress and avoid claiming real transcription or confirmed product outcomes. Independent source inspection confirms the reported A defects and B bookkeeping mechanisms. This supports local mechanism and interpretation findings only; it establishes neither model superiority nor live product capability.

mechanism_and_producer_findings.source_equivalence: Within each arm, Riffrec and Sweep analyzer files are byte-identical. This establishes duplicated analyzer implementation behavior, not spec-sweep Skill entrypoint behavior.
A_root_mechanisms: transcribe_media_chunks chooses aggregate success from nonempty transcript text rather than complete successful chunk coverage.
main replaces the initial result with fallback output, losing prior request-attempt truth.
summarize_candidate_findings invents a no-failure placeholder; write_requirements_kickoff promotes findings into R-items and includes unsupported friction/example text.
B_mechanisms: Chunk statuses determine explicit covered/missing intervals and partial/failed/ok aggregation, preserving empty successful text.
Authorization is checked before chunk extraction.
transcribe_with_fallback retains compact attempts and ORs request flags.
Quiet findings remain empty and product requirements remain unconfirmed.
mechanism_and_producer_findings.producer_cleanup: prepare-media.py writes scratch_removed_after_capture=True inside TemporaryDirectory without a post-exit existence measurement. The base flag is hardcoded and proves no measured cleanup. prepare-media-supplement.py evaluates not p.exists() after context exit. Its four arm/entrypoint checks support only those disposable roots.
mechanism_and_producer_findings.fairness: Trials were not permitted to inspect producer scripts. Failure to discover the hardcoded base flag is not a model failure; each artifact explicitly withholds established base post-context timing.
mechanism_and_producer_findings.egress_totals: Per arm: seven mocked provider calls per entrypoint across chunk cases, plus one supplement call each: sixteen provider attempts. A has twenty mocked extraction calls across both entrypoints; B has sixteen. All actual_egress fields are false. These are separate fixture totals, not one production session.
mechanism_and_producer_findings.execution_limit: Producer source and stored receipts support mocked Python control-flow observations. No independent rerun occurred.

integrity_and_trace_review.allowed_reads: All observed trial commands are cat, sed, wc, or rg over assigned-arm frozen Riffrec Skill/own references, request, and assigned receipt files.
integrity_and_trace_review.forbidden_reads_or_actions: No observed opposite-arm reads, prior-trial/grader reads, current-runtime reads, adjacent Sweep Skill reads, analyzer execution, mutation, external contact, or delegation.
